# Question 2

```{r}
Mean_Uniform_Histogram <- function(times_sample, num_samples, lambda) {
    set.seed(1234)
    means <- rep(0, times=times_sample)
    
    for (i in 1:times_sample) {
        sample <- rexp(num_samples, rate = lambda)
        means[i] <- mean(sample)
    }
    
    hist(means, xlab = "Means", breaks = 10, col = "lightblue")


}
par(mfrow=c(1, 1))

Mean_Uniform_Histogram(times_sample = 10, num_samples = 100, lambda = 3)
Mean_Uniform_Histogram(times_sample = 10, num_samples = 100, lambda = 3)
Mean_Uniform_Histogram(times_sample = 10, num_samples = 100, lambda = 3)
```
